description:
Summary 
 As part of Workiva's Growth Solutions team, the Forward Deployed Engineer serves as a forward-deployed builder, applying GenAI engineering to complex reporting and regulatory challenges. Working directly with customers across financial reporting, sustainability disclosure, tax transparency, audit, and other regulated domains, this role designs, builds, and deploys AI-powered solutions on the Workiva platform. Success requires balancing innovation with the governance, auditability, and scalability needed for production use in highly regulated environments. 

 This is not a traditional implementation role. The Forward Deployed Engineer combines customer-facing solution delivery with AI application development, including agent-based workflows, prompt engineering, system integration, and solution architecture. In close partnership with customer stakeholders, Sales, Product Management, and Engineering, this role defines new solutions through deeply understanding of customer needs. 

 The Forward Deployed Engineer works within a purpose-built operating model alongside Product Management and Engineering. Product owns solution strategy and roadmap; Engineering builds and maintains the platform; the Forward Deployed Engineer owns what happens at the edge, deploying existing and emerging platform capabilities against real customer problems while continuously feeding discoveries back to Product and Engineering. This role solves immediate customer problems while creating reusable patterns and insights that help shape future platform capabilities. 

 What You'll Do 

 Own the hardest customer problems end-to-end 
 Take ambiguous, first-of-their-kind customer problems and drive them from prototype to stable production across multiple deployments. You own technical delivery, and you own whether it actually works for the customer 
 
 Design and deploy AI-powered workflows 
 Design and deploy AI-powered workflows that address real customer challenges, building, testing, and operationalizing solutions while establishing appropriate controls for human review, exception management, and governance in regulated environments. The specific techniques evolve constantly; what matters is the ability to work at the frontier, figure out what hasn't been figured out yet, and turn that into something stable and repeatable 
 
 Drive customer outcomes 
 Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer regulatory, operations, and IT stakeholders. Facilitate executive discussions, technical workshops, and solution reviews while helping customers achieve measurable business outcomes and long-term adoption 
 
 Shape the next generation of customer solutions through hands-on development 
 Fieldwork is where the next generation of platform capability comes from. Turn recurring customer problems and real-world outcomes into the evaluation criteria, patterns, and priorities that Product and Engineering build into the platform. The frontier moves because of what is found at the edge 
 
 Contribute to a compounding knowledge base 
 What you discover at the customer becomes what the team knows collectively. You'll contribute patterns, methods, and field learnings into the shared knowledge environment, building a compounding base of expertise that every SDC draws on. That includes peer mentoring, but the real contribution is the institutional knowledge you build, not just the individual relationships 
 
 What You'll Need 

 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience 
 5+ years of experience delivering software solutions to enterprise customers 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with reporting and analytics technology, financial, sustainability, governance, risk, compliance, or adjacent domains 
 Experience configuring, customizing, and delivering software solutions in customer environments, owning complex implementations from requirements through deployment and adoption 
 Ability to engage credibly with both technical and business stakeholders, including regulatory teams, IT, and executive sponsors 
 Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or comparable ecosystems and common integration patterns 
 Experience working alongside external implementation partners, advisory firms, systems integrators, or audit firms 
 Knowledge of prompt engineering, agent-based architectures, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation frameworks, and AI application lifecycle management 
 
 Travel Requirements and Working Conditions 
 25% Travel for internal meetings 
 Reliable internet access for any period of time, working remotely and not in a Workiva office 
 

Workiva will not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. on a permanent basis.

 How You’ll Be Rewarded 
 
✅ Salary range in the US: $111,000.00 - $180,000.00 ✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually
 ✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire
 ✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package
 
 The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.
 
 Why Join Workiva 
 
 Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world. 
 
 At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you. 
 
 Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.
 
 Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email talentacquisition@workiva.com .
 
 Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.
 
 Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.
